::: {.callout-note}
## About this book
Book_29 examines how CrowdStrike Falcon replaces Active Directory Group Policy as the endpoint security enforcement data plane, governed by UIAO's OrgPath organizational model. The book traces the governance gap left by AD migration, shows how OrgPath-derived sensor policies restore deterministic endpoint security baselines, and defines the DRIFT taxonomy for endpoint governance failures.
:::
